mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month preceding the forecast period coincides with a compression of near-term discount rates, reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the preceding month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from the prior month's average (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed rate hikes above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it reflects accelerating inflation expectations that compress real equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05) during months with CPIAUCSL > +2% change.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 3% for two consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS month-on-month increase ≥ 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) during qualifying labor strength episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (billions of chained USD) grows by at least 10% in a quarter relative to the prior quarter, it indicates robust consumer and business demand, which supports higher corporate earnings forecasts and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth ≥ +10% vs prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are flat or negative during confirmed GDPC1 ≥ +10% quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in INDPRO (index 2017=100) of at least 5 points over two months suggests weakening manufacturing capacity utilization, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-on-month decline ≥ 5 points for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during INDPRO contraction episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in HOUST (units) and RSAFS (dollars) above their prior month's levels by at least 5% each indicate intensified market activity and liquidity, which are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during simultaneous liquidity proxies' double-move.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months, it reflects weakening labor market tightness and rising wage flexibility, which reduces wage growth pressures and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed UNRATE < 4.5% episodes.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of monetary easing (as signaled by FEDFUNDS < 3.5%), the 6-month rolling average of S&P 500 1-month implied volatility tends to decrease, reflecting reduced market uncertainty and supporting positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rolling avg < 3.5% over the past 6 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the 6-month pre-easing average (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed easing periods.
